text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Feb 4 - Bombay - No labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage. 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Berthing delays expected, container vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 8-10 days, general cargo vessels 2-3 days. Calcutta - Four vessels loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. 16 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 5 products tankers, 1 coke, 5 containers, 1 wood-pulp, 1 timber, 1 crude oil). Cochin - No labour problems. Three vessels discharging at berth, 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 small vessels at dry-dock, 1 vessel at shipyard vessel for repairs/fitting. 9 vessels due with up to 1 days delay expected.

Chennai (Dras) - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchor to discharge, 1 dredger dry-docked for repairs. 39 Vessels due by 11/2 of which 13 general cargo, 1 edible oil, 6 coal, 11 containers, 1 ore, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 wheat, 2 scrap, 3 ferrous metal. Delays, coal/coke 3-4 days, fertiliser/others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, no delays for containers/iron ore. Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 2 loading at anchor, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 2 awaiting orders. 12 Vessels due (8 ore, 1 alumina, 1 molasses, 1 naphtha, 1 phosphoric acid) with following delays, ore 5-6 days, alumina/molasses 1-2 days, naphtha 1 day, no delays for phosphoric acid.

Kandla - Eight vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 3 under arrest, 3 tankers, 16 vessels waiting, 17 due with 6-7 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Six vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 vessels awaiting berths, 1 vessel under arrest, 10 due with 3-4 days delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. No vessels berthed, 1 tanker waiting at anchorage to load, 3 tanker/iron ore vessels due, with 2-3 days berthing delay expected. 6-8 Days berthing delay expected for fertiliser/raw materials vessels.

Paradip - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 7 Vessels due (2 coal, 2 chrome, 1 fertiliser, 1 oil, 1 chemicals/gas) with up to 1 days delay expected. Tuticorin - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 due with 2-3 days delay expected at present. Visakhapatnam - Nine vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 5 waiting to load at inner harbour berth. 15 Vessels due (7 export - 2 iron ore, 1 pig-iron, 1 deformed bars, 1 thermal coal, 1 soya bean meal, 1 bagged sugar, 8 import - 2 coking coal, 1 timber logs, 1 rock phosphate, 1 sun flower oil, 1 liquid ammonia, 1 general cargo, 1 phosphoric acid). Berthing delays, iron ore/pig-iron/deformed bars/soya bean meal 7-8 days, bagged sugar 1-2 days, coking coal 2-3 days, timber logs 4-5 days, sun floweroil/general cargo 3-4 days, thermal coal/liquid ammonia/

MALAYSIA - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 3 days waiting time expected. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 due today, 6 waiting with 2-3 days waiting time expected. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 3 days waiting time expected. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 1 days waiting time expected. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. Cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 1 waiting with no delays. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, no waiting, no waiting time.

MAURITIUS, Feb 4 - Port Louis - Port working normally. Three container vessels berthed discharging/loading, 2 general cargo vessels berthed and discharging. 1 Vessel at buoy discharging bagged rice into lighters, 6 fishing vessels, no idle vessels in port, 2 waiting at outer anchorage to discharge, 1 dry-docked.

PAKISTAN, Feb 2 - Karachi - Three rice vessels loading at berth, 7 container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 9 vessels discharging at berth (sugar/urea/general cargo/dap/palm oil). 7 Rice/general cargo vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 15 vessels waiting to discharge (containers/fertiliser/hsd/oil). 4 Vessels awaiting orders, 2 due. Delays expected, general cargo/containers 1-2 days, rice loaders 11 days, fertiliser 33 days. Port Qasim - Six vessels loading at berth (sugar/fuel oil/coal/wheat/chemicals). No vessels waiting at anchorage.

PHILIPPINES, Feb 4 - Manila - South harbour - 7 Vessels discharging at berth, 3 discharging at anchorage, 2 waiting at outside anchorage to discharge, 1 other awaiting orders etc. Average waiting time for vessels with draft greater than 9 m and loa greater than 140 m 1-2 days.

SIERRA LEONE, Feb 3 - Freetown - No labour problems. For security reasons, vessels must endeavour to be in,out of port before 19.00 hrs. One sugar discharger discharging at berth, 1 vessel at anchor and under arrest, 2 vessels due of which 1 oil discharger, 1 container discharger, no delays expected.

SINGAPORE, Feb 4 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container pier - 10 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 15 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 7 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 6 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - No vessels. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 29 Tankers berthed, minimal berthing delays at all piers, terminals, ports, buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, Feb 4 - Inchon - Sixty-seven vessels in port (52 berthed, 15 anchored) of which berthed, 16 general cargo, 5 logs, 5 containers, 4 steel, 3 cars, 3 corn, 3 scrap, 2 ply-wood, 2 wheat, 2 raw sugar, 1 steel plates, 1 lupins, 1 pig-iron, 1 bananas, 1 molasses, 1 silica sand, 1 wheat bnding pellets. Vessels anchored, 2 containers, 2 pulp, 1 corn, 1 wheat, 1 cars, 1 coils, 1 raw sugar, 1 cotton seed meal, 1 ply-wood, 1 molasses, 1 logs, 1 steel plate, 1 steel, approx. 1 days berthing delay expected at present. Busan - One hundred and sixty-nine vessels in port (48 berthed, 121 anchored including 61 laid-up), of which berthed, 33 general cargo, 7 containers, 4 scrap, 4 coal. 60 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - Thirty-three vessels in port (25 berthed, 8 anchored) of which discharging, 4 billets, 4 scrap, 3 pipes, 2 coal, 2 iron ore, 2 coils, 1 plate, 1 logs. 6 Steel vessels loading, 8 vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Ulsan - Twenty-four vessels in port (all berthed), of which discharging, 3 chemicals, 2 feed meal, 2 crude oil, 1 kaolin, 1 wood-chip, 1 cement, 1 cotton seed meal, 1 sugar, 1 soda ash, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 phosphate cilicate, 1 fuel oil, 1 propane. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 1 steel pipes, 1 chemicals, 1 diesel oil. No berthing delays expected. Masan - Six vessels in port (all berthed), of which discharging, 2 steel scrap, 1 logs, 1 pig-iron. Vessels loading, 1 containers, 1 steel pipes, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Feb 4 - Colombo - Fourteen vessels loading at berth (4 essential services, 10 containers). 18 Discharging at berth (2 bagged sugar, 10 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk tallow, 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged rice, ro-ro). 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (1 bagged rice, 1 bagged cement, 2 bagged sugar, 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged copra). 9 Container vessels waiting to discharge/load, 1 vessel bunkering, 1 under repair, 4 dry-docked, 9 awaiting orders. 14 vessels due of which 8 containers, 6 general cargo, with 2-3 days delay expected for conventional vessels. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - Two vessels discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, Feb 1 - Keelung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 4 days, coal 9 days, steel 5 days, iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain/steel 1 days, iron/coal 3 days. (CSC berth) - Coal/scrap 2 days (public berth). Taichung - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 2-3 days, iron ore/coal/steel/other 1-2 days, scrap 1 day. Kaohsiung, Feb 5 - 61 Vessels in port of which 12 containers, 7 tankers, 2 grain, 1 other bulker, 29 general cargo. 10 At buoys, 12 general cargo vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
